0022600122.text: The Heat, who are 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the 1-2 Mavericks with Miami 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back. Dallas, 12th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Kyrie Irving (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Miami has no players listed as unavailable. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, with Dallas winning the last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
